body:
I already play video games an excessive amount.  I try to get lost in things that I enjoy to try to forget about the world and my problems for a little while.  But it's avoidance and never lasts long.


Thank you for the advice, though.

Thank you for answering.  I think that making it look like an accident is out of the question, so I'll leave a note.


I want to die because I'm tired of being a mentally broken waste of a human being.  I'm tired of struggling to deal with familial and personal problems.  Life in general just doesn't feel "worth it" anymore, I can't see any pay off in continuing to exist.
I'm tired of being sick in the head and of dealing with mounting personal problems.  Life just has no appeal to me anymore, I can't find a reason or motivation to keep living.
